name: main
_comment: ROM 0x1CD60..0xA6C70 loads directly after the boot BSS (boot BSS = 0x8001C160..0x80053710). vram - rom = 0x800369B0 for every block, derived by matching jal targets to function prologues. Last code at ~0x800D20A0, data to 0x800DD620, then BSS. bss_size is an estimate reaching ~0x80170000; refine once the game's DMA/segment table is found.
